urls.rationale: 42.17.370 Commission -- Additional powers — Public Disclosure Commission authority including suspension/modification of reporting requirements (the pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.120).
42.17.150 Registration of lobbyists — the central lobbyist-registration requirement (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.600).
42.17.155 Photograph and information -- Booklet -- Publication — publication of registered-lobbyist information (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.605).
42.17.160 Exemption from registration — scope carve-outs from the lobbyist-registration regime (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.610).
42.17.170 Reporting by lobbyists — periodic lobbyist activity/expenditure reports (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.615).
42.17.172 Notification to person named in report — disclosure-notice obligations under the lobbyist-reporting regime (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.620).
42.17.175 Special reports -- Lobbyists -- Late contributions or large totals (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.625).
42.17.180 Reports by employers of registered lobbyists, other persons — disclosure obligations on lobbyist principals (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.630).
42.17.190 Legislative activities of state agencies, other units of government, elective officials, employees — public-sector lobbying disclosure (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.635).
42.17.200 Grass roots lobbying campaigns — indirect-lobbying disclosure requirement (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.640).

42.17.210 Employment of legislators, board or commission members, or state employees -- Statement, contents and filing — disclosure of lobbyist-side employment relationships (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.645).
42.17.220 Employment of unregistered persons — prohibitions tied to the lobbyist-registration regime (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.650).
42.17.230 Lobbyists' duties, restrictions — duties and prohibitions on registered lobbyists (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.655).
42.17.390 Civil remedies and sanctions — chapter-wide enforcement reaching lobbyist provisions (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.750).
42.17.395 Violations -- Determination by commission -- Procedure — chapter-wide enforcement (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.755).
42.17.400 Enforcement — chapter-wide enforcement provision (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.765).
42.17.410 Limitation on actions — limitation period for chapter violations including lobbyist-disclosure (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.770).

notes: 17 per-section URLs from Ch. 42.17 (pre-reorg). Coverage gap vs WA 2015 (19 URLs): missing 42.17A.005 (Definitions) and 42.17A.020 (Statements/reports public records) — the 2009 snapshot does not expose 42.17.010 or 42.17.020 as individual leaves (the chapter listing begins at 42.17.030). The WA 2010 chapter definitions historically lived at RCW 42.17.020 — by 2009 the section may already have been removed from Justia's per-section enumeration in anticipation of the 2012 reorg, or recodified into the parallel 42.17A.005 leaf which Justia DOES expose at this vintage but which was not yet operative. Treating this as a genuine availability gap rather than picking from the 42.17A side, since 42.17A's effective date was 2012-01-01 and the brief specifies the 2010 vintage. The 42.17 → 42.17A renumbering for the lobbying-disclosure subset is direct (per WA Code Reviser's 2012 reorg table): 42.17.150 ↔ 42.17A.600, .155 ↔ .605, .160 ↔ .610, .170 ↔ .615, .172 ↔ .620, .175 ↔ .625, .180 ↔ .630, .190 ↔ .635, .200 ↔ .640, .210 ↔ .645, .220 ↔ .650, .230 ↔ .655 (core); .370 ↔ .120 (PDC additional-powers / suspension-modification), .390 ↔ .750, .395 ↔ .755, .400 ↔ .765, .410 ↔ .770 (enforcement / limitations).
